meta.title: Zamana · Your plant care reminder
meta.description: Zamana reminds you when to water, feed or repot your plants, and warns you about frost and heatwaves. Free, no ads and no account: your plants stay on your phone.

promises.local: No account, your plants stay on your phone

hero.title: Your plants’ reminder
hero.description: Never forget to water your plants again! Zamana tells you when each one needs care, and warns you when it gets unusually cold or hot.
hero.screenAlt: The “Raven” plant page in the app: toxicity and light, watering, temperature and humidity needs.

features.title: Everything to look after your plants
features.description: Whether you have three cacti or a real jungle.

reminders.title: Care reminders
reminders.description: Watering, feeding, repotting, pruning: every plant has its own pace, and Zamana remembers it for you.

garden.title: Your garden
garden.description: A page for each plant, with its photo, its needs and its care history.

weather.title: Weather alerts
weather.description: Bring your plants indoors when the weather gets unusually cold or hot.

knowledge.title: Encyclopedia and tips
knowledge.description: Plant profiles and articles to learn how to look after each one.

items.seasons: Watering paced by seasons and climate

care.title: Every bit of care at the right time
care.description: Zamana works out when each task is next due from the last time you did it. One glance tells you what to do today, and what can wait.
care.screenAlt: The app’s “Care” screen: a watering due today and the upcoming tasks.

garden.title: All your plants in one place
garden.description: Find each one’s nickname, location and needs in an instant. And keep a record of those that are gone.
garden.screenAlt: The app’s “Garden” screen: the list of plants and their scientific names.

knowledge.title: Answers to your questions
knowledge.description: How do I know if my plant is thirsty? Should I repot it? Plant profiles and tips so you’re never in doubt again.
knowledge.screenAlt: The app’s “Tips” screen: articles sorted by category, from the basics to plant health.

today.title: A heads-up before frost or heatwaves
today.description: Zamana keeps an eye on the weather where your outdoor plants live. At the first cold snap or heatwave, an alert reminds you to bring them to shelter.
today.screenAlt: The app’s “Today” screen: a weather alert and today’s care tasks.

download.title: Your garden is waiting!
download.description: Zamana is coming soon to iOS and Android. 🌱
